**2. Composite density** — volume fractions given (vol%), so mass additivity gives the rule of mixtures (arithmetic):
$$\rho_c = V_W\rho_W + V_{Cu}\rho_{Cu} = 0.5(19.3) + 0.5(8.9) = 14.1\;\text{g/cm}^3 = 14100\;\text{kg/m}^3$$

$$L = \frac{1100\times10^{6}\;\text{Pa}}{14100\;\text{kg/m}^3 \times 9.81\;\text{m/s}^2} = 7952.5\;\text{m} = 7.95\times10^{6}\;\text{mm}$$
